message.content: On April 10th, 2026, during the discussion about the upcoming jam session, WolfgangSchulz suggested they try "Stand By Me" by Ben E. King. YurikoYamamoto agreed enthusiastically, stating that the song has a nice groove and they would enjoy playing it together. LiHua also expressed her approval, suggesting they explore a classic song that could fit well into their practice routine. Thus, the new song they decided to work on for the jam session is "Stand By Me."
